chapters.title: Merge one row at a time, keeping k

frames.caption: Row 0 = [1, 3, 11]: every kept sum (rows) plus every element of this row (columns). Only the k = 5 smallest can matter later, so keep those and drop the rest.
Row 1 = [2, 4, 6]: every kept sum (rows) plus every element of this row (columns). Only the k = 5 smallest can matter later, so keep those and drop the rest.
After the last row, the kept sums are the k smallest overall; the k-th is 7.
